Definition
[Tip Ansatz (Ansatz 36.6)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0344 ↗ def:chow-iv-tip-bryant-profile 1. ch36:36.6-ansatz\group Matched Asymptotics

In the tip region, as $t\uparrow T$, assume $\Gamma (\tau )\gg e^{\tau /2}$, $\partial _\tau \Gamma =o(\Gamma ^3)$, and $\partial _tZ=o(\Gamma ^2)$. Then the left side of the rescaled tip equation is negligible and the Bryant boundary-value equation governs the tip.
